title: The Cover-Up
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael becomes consumed by suspicion that his girlfriend Donna might be cheating on him, leading him to hire Dwight as a private investigator. Dwight's unconventional methods, including a plan to seduce Donna, add tension and humor. Meanwhile, Pam uncovers photos suggesting Donna has a complex personal life, and Michael struggles to confront the truth. Parallel to this, Andy and Darryl investigate faulty printers at the office, capturing dramatic evidence but facing uncertainty about the outcome. The episode culminates in a confusing and ambiguous exchange between Michael and Donna about their relationship status, while Dwight takes over a gym workout with his own intense style.
